description_en: Lists public applications on the platform
description_zh: 获取平台公共应用列表
kebab_example: aliyun easygene list-global-apps --search Population_variation --order-by AppName,_LastModified,_Used --is-reversed true --next-token 0f2cc944-67db-4fb1-bb10-f136cda74bda --max-results 10 --app-scope OpenAccess --category '群体变异' --toolkit Sentieon --location cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGlobalApps

parameters.description_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search. The system searches for matches in the NamespaceName, AppName, Categories, and AppDescription fields.

parameters.description_en: The field by which to sort the results.
